day_shape: 62 items: rial hits 2 million to the dollar, Araghchi and IRGC spokesman respond to Trump's 'economic war', Pakistan army chief Munir due in Tehran, IDF strikes across Gaza and southern Lebanon, no UK Parliament or OFAC output.

threads.label: Iranian currency and economic-pressure response
threads.summary: Iran International reported the dollar hitting 2 million rials on Sunday, with Jerusalem Post citing 'cracks' in the economy and canvassing further US sanctions options. Foreign Minister Araghchi, parliament speaker Qalibaf and an IRGC spokesman said on regime channels that Trump's 'economic war' would fail, while Mohsen Rezaee claimed Iran had made billions despite sanctions.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and kites from the Strip
threads.summary: Times of Israel's Fabian and Palestinian media reported Israeli airstrikes near Maghazi camp and Khan Younis, with one dead and several wounded; the IDF said one strike targeted a terror operative. Defence Minister Israel Katz instructed the IDF to 'act forcefully' after at least four kites flown from Gaza landed in Kibbutz Nahal Oz over the weekend.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy and alliance signalling
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry announced Pakistan army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir would travel to Tehran on Monday, and Jerusalem Post reported Iran had been invited to join the Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan 'Mecca Agreement' mutual-defence pact. Syria said it expected negotiations with Israel over a security deal to resume soon, while Defa Press quoted Bagheri protesting France's expulsion of two Iranian diplomats.

threads.label: Lebanon and Hezbollah
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the IDF was increasing its pace of destroying Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon on instructions from Defence Minister Katz. A World Bank Lebanon Economic Monitor cited by JPost projected Lebanon's economy would shrink 6.4% in 2026 after Hezbollah's return to war with Israel erased 2025's recovery.

threads.label: Iran cyber activity and internal repression
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported regime-affiliated Iranian hackers shut down a British power plant for four days in late July in an 'unprecedented' cyberattack. Iran International reported the judiciary executed another detainee from the January protests after the Supreme Court upheld his death sentence.

threads.label: Regime commemoration and 12-day-war messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran heavy commemorative output for Government Week and Physician's/Pharmacist's Day, including the president visiting the graves of martyrs Nasirzadeh and Kharazi and IRGC commander Vahidi's message. Quds Force commander Qaani said the 'Palestinian ideal from sea to river' was more alive than ever, and officials repeatedly invoked 'national cohesion' from the 12-day and Ramadan wars.

threads.label: Palestinian politics and Pahlavi coverage
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited a Palestinian Center for Policy and Survey Research poll showing support for Hamas had fallen sharply without benefiting the PA, and reported Hamas was exploring alliances with figures including Mohammed Dahlan ahead of Legislative Council elections. Separately JPost ran analysis asking why the Iranian regime continues efforts to discredit Reza Pahlavi.
